But he himself went a day’s journey into the wilderness, and came and sat down under a juniper tree. Then he requested…
“Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,
so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.
“Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me…
Cursed is the day in which I was born. Don’t let the day in which my mother bore me be blessed.
Therefore now, Yahweh, take, I beg you, my life from me; for it is better for me to die than to live.”
When the sun arose, God prepared a sultry east wind; and the sun beat on Jonah’s head, so that he fainted, and…
But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.
I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness…
So the Spirit lifted me up, and took me away; and I went in bitterness, in the heat of my spirit; and Yahweh’s hand was…
Why do you show me iniquity, and look at perversity? For destruction and violence are before me. There is strife, and…
Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was…
For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?
Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.
Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

translations.web: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.
translations.bsb: So I hated life, because the work that is done under the sun was grievous to me. For everything is futile and a pursuit of the wind.
translations.kjv: Therefore I hated life; because the work that is wrought under the sun is grievous unto me: for all is vanity and vexation of spirit.
translations.asv: So I hated life, because the work that is wrought under the sun was grievous unto me; for all is vanity and a striving after wind.
